```{r, include = FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(collapse = TRUE, comment = "#>")
```

Georeferenced conflict events differ in how precisely their locations and
dates are known. Spatial conversion should therefore be paired with an
explicit precision decision rather than treated as a purely technical step.

```{r}
library(ucdpR)

events <- data.frame(
  id = 1:6,
  country = c("A", "A", "A", "B", "B", "B"),
  year = c(2020, 2020, 2021, 2020, 2021, 2021),
  longitude = c(10.0, 10.4, 11.0, 20.0, 20.5, NA),
  latitude = c(50.0, 50.2, 51.0, 40.0, 40.4, NA),
  where_prec = c(1, 2, 4, 1, 3, 6),
  date_prec = c(1, 3, 4, 2, 5, 1)
)
```

## Describe precision before filtering

`where_prec` describes spatial precision and `date_prec` temporal precision.
The summary reports counts and within-group shares while retaining the numeric
codes used by UCDP.

```{r}
ucdp_precision(events)
ucdp_precision(events, by = "country")
ucdp_precision(events, by = "year", include_missing = FALSE)
```

## Make the analytical threshold explicit

Filtering by named arguments keeps the decision visible in the script. Here,
only events with relatively precise locations and dates are retained.

```{r}
precise_events <- ucdp_filter_precision(
  events,
  where_prec = 1:2,
  date_prec = 1:3,
  missing = "drop"
)
precise_events
```

There is no universally correct cutoff. The defensible choice depends on the
spatial resolution, research design, and consequences of assigning an
imprecise event to one spatial unit. Sensitivity analyses can repeat the same
workflow under alternative thresholds.

## Convert coordinates to `sf`

`ucdp_as_sf()` recognizes common longitude and latitude names, uses EPSG 4326
by default, and retains the `ucdp_source` provenance attribute when present.
The chunk is evaluated only when the optional `sf` package is installed.

```{r, eval = requireNamespace("sf", quietly = TRUE)}
events_sf <- ucdp_as_sf(precise_events)
events_sf
sf::st_crs(events_sf)
sf::st_coordinates(events_sf)
```

Missing coordinates can be retained as empty geometries, dropped, or treated
as an error:

```{r, eval = requireNamespace("sf", quietly = TRUE)}
ucdp_as_sf(events, missing = "keep")
ucdp_as_sf(events, missing = "drop")
```

## Prepare for downstream spatial packages

The resulting object is an ordinary `sf` data frame. It can therefore be
transformed, intersected, or spatially joined using standard `sf` operations.
It also provides the appropriate input shape for workflows that attach grid
identifiers or other geographic units.

Direct examples for `priogridR` will be added after its current public API has
been verified and a stable handoff has been implemented. For now, `ucdpR`
deliberately stops at a standards-based `sf` object rather than claiming an
integration that the package does not yet provide.

```{r, eval = FALSE}
ged <- ucdp_get("ged", version = "25.1")
ged_precise <- ucdp_filter_precision(ged, where_prec = 1:2)
ged_sf <- ucdp_as_sf(ged_precise)
```
